description.en: One of the two main arteries to the brain. It enters the skull through the carotid canal of the temporal bone, S-bends through the cavernous sinus (the carotid siphon) and ends beside the optic chiasm by dividing into the anterior and middle cerebral arteries.
description.uz: Miyaga boruvchi ikki asosiy arteriyadan biri. Bosh suyagiga chakka suyagining uyqu kanali orqali kiradi, g'orsimon sinus ichida S-shaklida egiladi (karotid sifon) va ko'rish kesishmasi yonida oldingi va o'rta miya arteriyalariga bo'linib tugaydi.

role.en: Supplies the anterior circulation — most of the cerebral hemispheres, the eye (ophthalmic artery) and, via the posterior communicating artery, links to the vertebrobasilar system in the circle of Willis.
role.uz: Oldingi qon aylanishini ta'minlaydi — bosh miya yarim sharlarining ko'p qismi, ko'z (ko'z arteriyasi) va orqa bog'lovchi arteriya orqali Willis halqasida vertebrobazilyar tizim bilan bog'lanadi.

clinical.en: Atherosclerotic stenosis at its origin in the neck is a major cause of ischaemic stroke and transient monocular blindness (amaurosis fugax); treated by endarterectomy or stenting. Dissection causes stroke in young people. Cavernous-segment aneurysms press on CN III–VI.
clinical.uz: Bo'yindagi boshlanish joyida aterosklerotik torayish ishemik insult va o'tkinchi bir ko'z ko'rligining (amaurosis fugax) asosiy sababi; endarterektomiya yoki stent bilan davolanadi. Dissektsiyasi yoshlarda insult beradi. G'orsimon segment anevrizmalari III–VI nervlarni bosadi.

description.en: The left internal carotid artery — see the right one for the full description. It arises from the left common carotid, which itself springs directly from the aortic arch.
description.uz: Chap ichki uyqu arteriyasi — to'liq tavsif o'ng tomonda. Bevosita aorta ravog'idan chiquvchi chap umumiy uyqu arteriyasidan boshlanadi.

role.en: Anterior circulation of the left hemisphere — in most people the language-dominant side.
role.uz: Chap yarim sharning oldingi qon aylanishi — ko'pchilikda nutq-dominant tomon.

clinical.en: Left-sided carotid stroke typically adds aphasia to right hemiparesis.
clinical.uz: Chap tomon karotid insulti odatda o'ng gemiparezga afaziya qo'shadi.

description.en: Arises from the subclavian artery, climbs through the transverse foramina of C6–C1, loops behind the atlas, pierces the dura and enters the skull through the foramen magnum. The two vertebral arteries unite at the lower border of the pons to form the basilar artery.
description.uz: O'mrov osti arteriyasidan boshlanib, C6–C1 ko'ndalang teshiklaridan ko'tariladi, atlant orqasidan aylanib, qattiq pardani teshib katta teshik orqali bosh suyagiga kiradi. Ikki umurtqa arteriyasi ko'prikning pastki chegarasida qo'shilib bazilyar arteriyani hosil qiladi.

role.en: With the basilar it forms the posterior circulation: brainstem, cerebellum, occipital lobes and the inferior temporal lobes. Gives off the PICA and the anterior spinal artery.
role.uz: Bazilyar bilan birga orqa qon aylanishini tashkil qiladi: miya ustuni, miyacha, ensa bo'laklari va pastki chakka bo'laklari. PICA va oldingi orqa miya arteriyasini beradi.

clinical.en: Dissection (after neck manipulation or trauma) is a leading cause of stroke in the young; occlusion causes lateral medullary (Wallenberg) syndrome. Vertebrobasilar insufficiency gives vertigo, diplopia and drop attacks.
clinical.uz: Dissektsiyasi (bo'yin manipulyatsiyasi yoki jarohatdan keyin) yoshlarda insultning asosiy sabablaridan biri; tiqilishi lateral medullar (Vallenberg) sindromi beradi. Vertebrobazilyar yetishmovchilik bosh aylanishi, diplopiya va yiqilish xurujlari beradi.

description.en: The right vertebral artery — see the left for the full description. One vertebral artery is often dominant (larger) than the other.
description.uz: O'ng umurtqa arteriyasi — to'liq tavsif chap tomonda. Ko'pincha bir umurtqa arteriyasi ikkinchisidan dominant (kattaroq).

role.en: Posterior circulation of the brainstem and cerebellum.
role.uz: Miya ustuni va miyachaning orqa qon aylanishi.

clinical.en: A hypoplastic side is a normal variant that must not be mistaken for stenosis on angiography.
clinical.uz: Gipoplastik tomon — angiografiyada torayish bilan adashtirmaslik kerak bo'lgan normal variant.

description.en: A single midline artery formed by the two vertebral arteries, running up the front of the pons in the basilar groove and dividing at the top of the pons into the two posterior cerebral arteries.
description.uz: Ikki umurtqa arteriyasidan hosil bo'lgan yagona o'rta chiziq arteriyasi; ko'prik old yuzasidagi bazilyar egat bo'ylab ko'tarilib, ko'prik tepasida ikki orqa miya arteriyasiga bo'linadi.

role.en: Supplies the pons (pontine arteries), the cerebellum (AICA, SCA) and the inner ear (labyrinthine artery), and feeds the posterior cerebral arteries.
role.uz: Ko'prikni (ko'prik arteriyalari), miyachani (AICA, SCA) va ichki quloqni (labirint arteriyasi) ta'minlaydi, orqa miya arteriyalarini oziqlantiradi.

clinical.en: Basilar occlusion is one of the most devastating strokes: coma, quadriplegia or the locked-in syndrome; 'top of the basilar' syndrome causes visual and behavioural disturbances. Thrombectomy has transformed its outcome.
clinical.uz: Bazilyar tiqilishi eng og'ir insultlardan biri: koma, tetraplegiya yoki 'qulflangan odam' sindromi; 'bazilyar uchi' sindromi ko'rish va xulq buzilishlarini beradi. Trombektomiya natijasini tubdan o'zgartirdi.

description.en: The smaller terminal branch of the internal carotid. It runs forward above the optic nerve, meets its partner through the anterior communicating artery (A1 segment), then curves up and back over the corpus callosum (A2 onward) as the pericallosal artery with its callosomarginal branch.
description.uz: Ichki uyqu arteriyasining kichikroq terminal shoxi. Ko'rish nervi ustidan oldinga o'tadi, oldingi bog'lovchi arteriya orqali jufti bilan uchrashadi (A1 segmenti), so'ng qadoq tana ustidan yuqoriga va orqaga (A2 va undan keyin) perikallozal arteriya sifatida kallozomarginal shoxi bilan egiladi.

role.en: Supplies the medial surface of the frontal and parietal lobes — the leg area of the motor and sensory cortex — plus the corpus callosum and, via the recurrent artery of Heubner, the caudate head and anterior limb of the internal capsule.
role.uz: Peshona va tepa bo'laklarining medial yuzasini — harakat va sezgi po'stlog'ining oyoq sohasini — hamda qadoq tanani va Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi orqali kaudat boshi va ichki kapsula oldingi oyog'ini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: ACA stroke: weakness and numbness of the opposite leg, urinary incontinence, apathy and abulia; bilateral infarcts (from an ACom aneurysm rupture or vasospasm) cause akinetic mutism.
clinical.uz: ACA insulti: qarama-qarshi oyoqda kuchsizlik va uvishish, siydik tuta olmaslik, apatiya va abuliya; ikki tomonlama infarktlar (ACom anevrizmasi yorilishi yoki vazospazmdan) akinetik mutizm beradi.

description.en: A short artery, a few millimetres long, joining the two anterior cerebral arteries in the midline above the optic chiasm — the front of the circle of Willis.
description.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi ustida o'rta chiziqda ikki oldingi miya arteriyasini bog'lovchi bir necha millimetrlik qisqa arteriya — Willis halqasining old qismi.

role.en: Lets blood pass from one carotid to the other if one is blocked; gives tiny perforators to the hypothalamus, fornix and optic chiasm.
role.uz: Biri tiqilsa qonning bir uyqu arteriyasidan ikkinchisiga o'tishiga imkon beradi; gipotalamus, fornix va ko'rish kesishmasiga mayda perforant shoxlar beradi.

clinical.en: The single commonest site of intracranial aneurysm; rupture causes subarachnoid haemorrhage ('worst headache of my life'), and injury to its perforators causes amnesia and confabulation.
clinical.uz: Bosh suyagi ichi anevrizmasining eng ko'p uchraydigan joyi; yorilishi subaraxnoidal qon quyilishi ('hayotimdagi eng kuchli bosh og'rig'i') beradi, perforantlari zararlansa amneziya va konfabulyatsiya.

description.en: The larger terminal branch of the internal carotid and the artery most often involved in stroke. Its M1 (sphenoidal) segment runs laterally under the anterior perforated substance giving off the lenticulostriate perforators, then it enters the lateral fissure (M2 insular segment) and divides into superior and inferior trunks whose cortical branches fan over the convexity.
description.uz: Ichki uyqu arteriyasining kattaroq terminal shoxi va insultda eng ko'p ishtirok etadigan arteriya. M1 (ponasimon) segmenti oldingi teshikli modda ostidan lateralga o'tib lentikulostriat perforantlarni beradi, so'ng lateral egatga kiradi (M2 insulyar segment) va po'stloq shoxlari yarim shar qavariq yuzasini qoplaydigan yuqori va pastki tanalarga bo'linadi.

role.en: Supplies most of the lateral hemisphere — the face and arm areas of motor and sensory cortex, Broca's and Wernicke's areas, the insula — and, through the lenticulostriate arteries, the putamen, globus pallidus and internal capsule.
role.uz: Lateral yarim sharning ko'p qismini — harakat va sezgi po'stlog'ining yuz va qo'l sohalari, Broka va Vernike maydonlari, insula — hamda lentikulostriat arteriyalar orqali putamen, globus pallidus va ichki kapsulani ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: MCA stroke: contralateral face-and-arm weakness and sensory loss, gaze deviation toward the lesion, homonymous hemianopia, aphasia (left) or neglect (right). A large M1 occlusion is the classic target of thrombectomy; the lenticulostriates are the site of hypertensive haemorrhage; the MCA bifurcation is a common aneurysm site.
clinical.uz: MCA insulti: qarama-qarshi yuz va qo'l kuchsizligi va sezgi yo'qolishi, ko'zlarning o'choqqa og'ishi, gomonim gemianopsiya, afaziya (chap) yoki e'tiborsizlik (o'ng). Katta M1 tiqilishi trombektomiyaning klassik nishoni; lentikulostriatlar gipertenziv qon quyilishi joyi; MCA bifurkatsiyasi tez-tez anevrizma joyi.

description.en: The terminal branch of the basilar artery. Its P1 segment runs from the basilar bifurcation to the posterior communicating artery; the P2 segment then winds around the midbrain above the tentorium to reach the under-surface of the temporal and occipital lobes.
description.uz: Bazilyar arteriyaning terminal shoxi. P1 segmenti bazilyar bifurkatsiyasidan orqa bog'lovchi arteriyagacha; P2 segmenti tentorium ustida o'rta miyani aylanib chakka va ensa bo'laklarining pastki yuzasiga yetadi.

role.en: Supplies the occipital lobe (primary visual cortex), the inferior temporal lobe and hippocampus, and via its perforators the thalamus and midbrain.
role.uz: Ensa bo'lagini (birlamchi ko'rish po'stlog'i), pastki chakka bo'lagi va hippokampni, perforantlari orqali talamus va o'rta miyani ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: PCA stroke: contralateral homonymous hemianopia with macular sparing; left-sided lesions add alexia without agraphia; thalamic perforator infarcts cause sensory loss and thalamic pain. Uncal herniation compresses it against the tentorium → occipital infarct.
clinical.uz: PCA insulti: makula saqlangan qarama-qarshi gomonim gemianopsiya; chap tomon zararlanishi agrafiyasiz aleksiya qo'shadi; talamus perforantlari infarkti sezgi yo'qolishi va talamik og'riq beradi. Uncal churra uni tentoriumga siqadi → ensa infarkti.

description.en: Runs backward from the internal carotid to join the posterior cerebral artery, closing the side of the circle of Willis; it passes just above the oculomotor nerve.
description.uz: Ichki uyqu arteriyasidan orqaga borib orqa miya arteriyasiga qo'shiladi va Willis halqasining yon tomonini yopadi; ko'zni harakatlantiruvchi nervning bevosita ustidan o'tadi.

role.en: Connects the anterior and posterior circulations; gives perforators to the hypothalamus, thalamus and optic tract. In a 'fetal' variant it is the main supply of the PCA.
role.uz: Oldingi va orqa qon aylanishlarini bog'laydi; gipotalamus, talamus va ko'rish traktiga perforantlar beradi. 'Fetal' variantda PCAning asosiy manbai.

clinical.en: The second commonest aneurysm site; an expanding PCom aneurysm causes a painful third-nerve palsy with a dilated pupil — a warning sign of impending rupture.
clinical.uz: Anevrizmaning ikkinchi eng ko'p uchraydigan joyi; kengayayotgan PCom anevrizmasi kengaygan qorachiq bilan og'riqli uchinchi nerv falaji beradi — yaqinlashayotgan yorilish belgisi.

description.en: A small but important branch of the internal carotid just before its terminal division, running back along the optic tract to the choroid plexus of the temporal horn.
description.uz: Ichki uyqu arteriyasining terminal bo'linishidan bevosita oldingi kichik, lekin muhim shoxi; ko'rish trakti bo'ylab orqaga, chakka shoxi tomirli chigaliga boradi.

role.en: Supplies the posterior limb of the internal capsule, the optic tract, the lateral geniculate body, the hippocampus and the choroid plexus.
role.uz: Ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i, ko'rish trakti, lateral tizzasimon tana, hippokamp va tomirli chigalni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Occlusion gives the classic triad of contralateral hemiplegia, hemianaesthesia and homonymous hemianopia.
clinical.uz: Tiqilishi klassik uchlikni beradi: qarama-qarshi gemiplegiya, gemianesteziya va gomonim gemianopsiya.

description.en: The first intracranial branch of the internal carotid, entering the orbit through the optic canal below the optic nerve.
description.uz: Ichki uyqu arteriyasining bosh suyagi ichidagi birinchi shoxi; ko'rish kanali orqali, ko'rish nervi ostidan ko'z kosasiga kiradi.

role.en: Supplies the eye (central retinal artery), the orbit, and the forehead and scalp, where it anastomoses with external carotid branches.
role.uz: Ko'zni (to'r pardaning markaziy arteriyasi), ko'z kosasini hamda peshona va bosh terisini ta'minlaydi; u yerda tashqi uyqu arteriyasi shoxlari bilan anastomoz hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Central retinal artery occlusion causes sudden painless blindness; emboli from a carotid plaque cause amaurosis fugax. Reversed flow in it is a sign of severe carotid stenosis.
clinical.uz: To'r parda markaziy arteriyasi tiqilishi to'satdan og'riqsiz ko'rlik beradi; karotid pilakchasidan emboliyalar amaurosis fugax beradi. Undagi teskari oqim og'ir karotid torayishining belgisi.

description.en: Arises from the basilar just below its bifurcation, separated from the posterior cerebral artery by the oculomotor nerve, and winds around the midbrain to the upper cerebellum.
description.uz: Bazilyar arteriyadan bifurkatsiyasidan bevosita pastda boshlanadi, orqa miya arteriyasidan ko'zni harakatlantiruvchi nerv bilan ajralgan, o'rta miyani aylanib miyachaning yuqori qismiga boradi.

role.en: Supplies the superior surface of the cerebellum, the dentate nucleus, the superior cerebellar peduncle and part of the midbrain and pons.
role.uz: Miyachaning yuqori yuzasi, tishsimon yadro, yuqori miyacha oyoqchasi hamda o'rta miya va ko'prikning bir qismini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: The commonest vessel compressing the trigeminal root in trigeminal neuralgia; SCA infarction causes ipsilateral limb ataxia and contralateral loss of pain and temperature.
clinical.uz: Uch shoxli nerv nevralgiyasida nerv ildizini siquvchi eng ko'p uchraydigan tomir; SCA infarkti o'sha tomonda oyoq-qo'l ataksiyasi va qarama-qarshi tomonda og'riq-harorat sezgisi yo'qolishini beradi.

description.en: Arises from the lower basilar and runs laterally to the cerebellopontine angle, usually giving off the labyrinthine artery to the inner ear.
description.uz: Bazilyar arteriyaning pastki qismidan boshlanib, lateralga miyacha-ko'prik burchagiga boradi; odatda ichki quloqqa labirint arteriyasini beradi.

role.en: Supplies the anterior inferior cerebellum, the middle cerebellar peduncle, the lateral pons and (via the labyrinthine artery) the cochlea and vestibule.
role.uz: Miyachaning oldingi pastki qismi, o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi, ko'prikning lateral qismi va (labirint arteriyasi orqali) chig'anoq hamda dahlizni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: AICA stroke: sudden deafness and vertigo with ipsilateral facial palsy and ataxia (lateral pontine syndrome).
clinical.uz: AICA insulti: to'satdan karlik va bosh aylanishi, o'sha tomonda yuz falaji va ataksiya (lateral ko'prik sindromi).

description.en: The largest branch of the vertebral artery, with a tortuous course around the medulla and the cerebellar tonsil to the under-surface of the cerebellum.
description.uz: Umurtqa arteriyasining eng katta shoxi; uzunchoq miya va miyacha bodomchasi atrofida egri-bugri yo'l bilan miyachaning pastki yuzasiga boradi.

role.en: Supplies the lateral medulla, the inferior cerebellum and the choroid plexus of the fourth ventricle.
role.uz: Uzunchoq miyaning lateral qismi, miyachaning pastki qismi va to'rtinchi qorincha tomirli chigalini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Occlusion causes lateral medullary (Wallenberg) syndrome — vertigo, dysphagia, hoarseness, ipsilateral Horner syndrome and facial pain loss, contralateral body pain loss. Cerebellar PICA infarcts can swell and compress the brainstem.
clinical.uz: Tiqilishi lateral medullar (Vallenberg) sindromini beradi — bosh aylanishi, disfagiya, bo'g'iq ovoz, o'sha tomonda Horner sindromi va yuz og'riq sezgisi yo'qolishi, qarama-qarshi tomonda tana og'riq sezgisi yo'qolishi. Miyacha PICA infarktlari shishib miya ustunini siqishi mumkin.

description.en: A branch of the maxillary artery that enters the skull through the foramen spinosum and grooves the inner surface of the temporal and parietal bones.
description.uz: Yuqori jag' arteriyasining shoxi; bosh suyagiga foramen spinosum orqali kiradi va chakka hamda tepa suyaklarining ichki yuzasida egat hosil qiladi.

role.en: Supplies the dura mater and the bones of the skull vault.
role.uz: Qattiq parda va bosh suyagi gumbazi suyaklarini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Torn by a fracture at the pterion (the thin temple), it causes an epidural haematoma — a lucid interval followed by rapid deterioration; a surgical emergency. Embolised to treat chronic subdural haematoma.
clinical.uz: Pterion (yupqa chakka) sinishida uzilib epidural gematoma beradi — 'yorug' oraliq'dan keyin tez yomonlashuv; jarrohlik shoshilinch holati. Surunkali subdural gematomani davolashda embolizatsiya qilinadi.

description.en: The large venous channel in the attached upper edge of the falx cerebri, running from the crista galli back to the confluence of sinuses at the internal occipital protuberance.
description.uz: Falx cerebri'ning birikkan yuqori qirrasidagi katta venoz kanal; crista galli'dan ichki ensa bo'rtig'idagi sinuslar qo'shilish joyigacha orqaga boradi.

role.en: Drains the superior cerebral veins and, through arachnoid granulations that bulge into it, returns cerebrospinal fluid to the blood.
role.uz: Yuqori miya venalarini yig'adi va unga bo'rtib kiruvchi araxnoid granulyatsiyalar orqali likvorni qonga qaytaradi.

clinical.en: Thrombosis (pregnancy, dehydration, the pill, infection) causes headache, seizures and bilateral venous infarcts; its posterior two-thirds cannot be sacrificed in surgery.
clinical.uz: Trombozi (homiladorlik, suvsizlanish, kontratseptivlar, infeksiya) bosh og'rig'i, tutqanoq va ikki tomonlama venoz infarktlar beradi; orqa uchdan ikki qismini jarrohlikda qurbon qilib bo'lmaydi.

description.en: A small sinus in the free lower edge of the falx cerebri, ending by joining the great cerebral vein to form the straight sinus.
description.uz: Falx cerebri erkin pastki qirrasidagi kichik sinus; katta miya venasi bilan qo'shilib to'g'ri sinusni hosil qilib tugaydi.

role.en: Drains the falx and the medial hemispheres.
role.uz: Falx va yarim sharlar medial yuzasini drenajlaydi.

clinical.en: Rarely important clinically; a landmark of the deep venous system.
clinical.uz: Klinik ahamiyati kam; chuqur venoz tizim mo'ljali.

description.en: Runs backward and downward along the junction of the falx and tentorium from the great cerebral vein to the confluence of sinuses.
description.uz: Falx va tentorium tutashgan joy bo'ylab katta miya venasidan sinuslar qo'shilish joyigacha orqaga va pastga boradi.

role.en: The main outflow of the deep venous system (thalamus, basal ganglia, deep white matter).
role.uz: Chuqur venoz tizimning (talamus, bazal yadrolar, chuqur oq modda) asosiy chiqish yo'li.

clinical.en: Deep venous thrombosis involving it causes bilateral thalamic oedema and coma.
clinical.uz: Uni qamrab olgan chuqur venoz tromboz ikki tomonlama talamus shishi va koma beradi.

description.en: The meeting point of the superior sagittal, straight and occipital sinuses at the internal occipital protuberance, from which the two transverse sinuses leave.
description.uz: Ichki ensa bo'rtig'ida yuqori sagittal, to'g'ri va ensa sinuslarining uchrashuv joyi; undan ikki ko'ndalang sinus chiqadi.

role.en: Distributes venous blood, usually asymmetrically, into the right and left transverse sinuses.
role.uz: Venoz qonni, odatda nosimmetrik, o'ng va chap ko'ndalang sinuslarga taqsimlaydi.

clinical.en: Must be located precisely before a posterior fossa or occipital craniotomy.
clinical.uz: Orqa chuqurcha yoki ensa kraniotomiyasidan oldin aniq topilishi shart.

description.en: Runs laterally from the confluence in the attached edge of the tentorium cerebelli, grooving the occipital bone, and becomes the sigmoid sinus. The right is usually larger.
description.uz: Sinuslar qo'shilish joyidan tentorium cerebelli'ning birikkan qirrasida lateralga, ensa suyagida egat hosil qilib boradi va sigmasimon sinusga aylanadi. O'ng tomondagisi odatda kattaroq.

role.en: Carries most of the brain's venous blood toward the internal jugular vein.
role.uz: Miya venoz qonining ko'p qismini ichki bo'yinturuq venasiga olib boradi.

clinical.en: Stenosis is linked to idiopathic intracranial hypertension (stenting); thrombosis follows mastoiditis; it marks the boundary between supra- and infratentorial craniotomies.
clinical.uz: Torayishi idiopatik bosh ichi gipertenziyasi bilan bog'liq (stent qo'yish); trombozi mastoiditdan keyin bo'ladi; supra- va infratentorial kraniotomiyalar chegarasini belgilaydi.

description.en: The S-shaped continuation of the transverse sinus, curving down behind the mastoid to the jugular foramen where it becomes the internal jugular vein.
description.uz: Ko'ndalang sinusning S-shaklidagi davomi; so'rg'ichsimon o'simta orqasidan pastga egilib bo'yinturuq teshigida ichki bo'yinturuq venasiga aylanadi.

role.en: The final intracranial segment of the main venous outflow.
role.uz: Asosiy venoz chiqishning bosh suyagi ichidagi oxirgi segmenti.

clinical.en: Thrombosis from middle-ear infection (otitic hydrocephalus); at risk during mastoid surgery and retrosigmoid craniotomy.
clinical.uz: O'rta quloq infeksiyasidan tromboz (otogen gidrotsefaliya); mastoid jarrohligi va retrosigmoid kraniotomiyada xavf ostida.

description.en: A trabeculated venous space on each side of the sella turcica and sphenoid body. The internal carotid artery and the abducens nerve run through it; the oculomotor, trochlear, ophthalmic and maxillary nerves lie in its lateral wall.
description.uz: Turk egari va ponasimon suyak tanasining har ikki yonidagi trabekulali venoz bo'shliq. Ichki uyqu arteriyasi va abducens nervi uning ichidan o'tadi; oculomotorius, trochlearis, ko'z va yuqori jag' nervlari lateral devorida yotadi.

role.en: Drains the orbit (ophthalmic veins), the pituitary and the anterior brain, emptying into the petrosal sinuses.
role.uz: Ko'z kosasi (ko'z venalari), gipofiz va oldingi miyani drenajlaydi, toshsimon sinuslarga quyiladi.

clinical.en: Cavernous sinus thrombosis (spread of facial infection via the valveless ophthalmic veins) causes proptosis, chemosis and palsies of CN III–VI; carotid-cavernous fistula gives a pulsating red eye; pituitary tumours invade it.
clinical.uz: G'orsimon sinus trombozi (yuz infeksiyasining klapansiz ko'z venalari orqali tarqalishi) proptoz, xemoz va III–VI nervlar falajini beradi; karotid-kavernoz fistula pulsatsiyalanuvchi qizil ko'z beradi; gipofiz o'smalari unga o'sib kiradi.

description.en: A small sinus in the attached edge of the tentorium along the top of the petrous temporal bone, from the cavernous sinus to the transverse sinus.
description.uz: Tentoriumning birikkan qirrasida, chakka suyagi toshsimon qismi tepasi bo'ylab g'orsimon sinusdan ko'ndalang sinusga boruvchi kichik sinus.

role.en: Drains the cavernous sinus and the cerebellum.
role.uz: G'orsimon sinus va miyachani drenajlaydi.

clinical.en: A landmark in surgery of the cerebellopontine angle and petroclival region.
clinical.uz: Miyacha-ko'prik burchagi va petroklival soha jarrohligida mo'ljal.

description.en: Runs in the groove between the petrous temporal and occipital bones from the cavernous sinus to the jugular bulb.
description.uz: Chakka suyagi toshsimon qismi bilan ensa suyagi orasidagi egatda g'orsimon sinusdan bo'yinturuq piyozchasiga boradi.

role.en: The main drainage of the cavernous sinus.
role.uz: G'orsimon sinusning asosiy drenaji.

clinical.en: Sampled by catheter (inferior petrosal sinus sampling) to prove a pituitary source of ACTH in Cushing disease.
clinical.uz: Kushing kasalligida ACTH manbai gipofiz ekanini isbotlash uchun kateter bilan namuna olinadi (pastki toshsimon sinus sampling).

description.en: A small, variable sinus in the attached edge of the falx cerebelli, running up from the foramen magnum to the confluence.
description.uz: Falx cerebelli'ning birikkan qirrasidagi kichik, o'zgaruvchan sinus; katta teshikdan sinuslar qo'shilish joyiga ko'tariladi.

role.en: Drains the posterior fossa dura and communicates with the vertebral venous plexus.
role.uz: Orqa chuqurcha qattiq pardasini drenajlaydi va umurtqa venoz chigali bilan bog'lanadi.

clinical.en: A large occipital sinus can bleed heavily during midline posterior fossa surgery.
clinical.uz: Katta ensa sinusi o'rta chiziq orqa chuqurcha jarrohligida kuchli qon ketishiga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

description.en: A short thick vein formed by the two internal cerebral veins under the splenium of the corpus callosum, curving up to join the inferior sagittal sinus and form the straight sinus.
description.uz: Qadoq tana spleniumi ostida ikki ichki miya venasidan hosil bo'lgan qisqa yo'g'on vena; yuqoriga egilib pastki sagittal sinus bilan qo'shilib to'g'ri sinusni hosil qiladi.

role.en: Collects all the deep venous blood of the brain (thalamus, basal ganglia, choroid plexus).
role.uz: Miyaning barcha chuqur venoz qonini (talamus, bazal yadrolar, tomirli chigal) yig'adi.

clinical.en: Vein of Galen malformation in infants causes heart failure and hydrocephalus; deep venous thrombosis is life-threatening.
clinical.uz: Chaqaloqlarda Galen venasi malformatsiyasi yurak yetishmovchiligi va gidrotsefaliya beradi; chuqur venoz tromboz hayot uchun xavfli.

description.en: Formed at the interventricular foramen by the thalamostriate and choroidal veins, it runs back in the roof of the third ventricle (tela choroidea) to join its partner as the great cerebral vein.
description.uz: Qorinchalararo teshikda talamostriat va tomirli chigal venalaridan hosil bo'lib, uchinchi qorincha tomida (tela choroidea) orqaga borib jufti bilan katta miya venasiga qo'shiladi.

role.en: Drains the thalamus, caudate, choroid plexus and deep white matter.
role.uz: Talamus, kaudat, tomirli chigal va chuqur oq moddani drenajlaydi.

clinical.en: Must be preserved in transcallosal approaches to the third ventricle; thrombosis causes bilateral thalamic infarction.
clinical.uz: Uchinchi qorinchaga transkallozal yondashuvlarda saqlanishi shart; trombozi ikki tomonlama talamus infarktini beradi.

description.en: Eight to twelve cortical veins on the upper lateral and medial surfaces of each hemisphere that cross the subdural space as 'bridging veins' to enter the superior sagittal sinus.
description.uz: Har yarim sharning yuqori lateral va medial yuzasidagi 8–12 ta po'stloq venasi; subdural bo'shliqni 'ko'prik venalari' sifatida kesib o'tib yuqori sagittal sinusga quyiladi.

role.en: Drain the cerebral cortex and subcortical white matter.
role.uz: Bosh miya po'stlog'i va po'stloq osti oq moddasini drenajlaydi.

clinical.en: Tearing of bridging veins (minor trauma in the elderly, alcohol, anticoagulants) causes subdural haematoma; the vein of Trolard is the large anastomotic one.
clinical.uz: Ko'prik venalarining uzilishi (keksalarda yengil jarohat, alkogol, antikoagulyantlar) subdural gematoma beradi; Trolard venasi — katta anastomoz venasi.

description.en: Runs along the lateral fissure, draining the surrounding cortex forward into the cavernous sinus; joined to the sagittal sinus by the vein of Trolard and to the transverse sinus by the vein of Labbé.
description.uz: Lateral egat bo'ylab o'tib, atrofdagi po'stloqni oldinga g'orsimon sinusga drenajlaydi; Trolard venasi orqali sagittal sinus, Labbé venasi orqali ko'ndalang sinus bilan bog'langan.

role.en: Superficial venous drainage of the lateral hemisphere with important anastomoses.
role.uz: Lateral yarim sharning yuzaki venoz drenaji, muhim anastomozlar bilan.

clinical.en: The vein of Labbé must be protected in temporal lobe surgery — its loss causes venous infarction of the temporal lobe.
clinical.uz: Labbé venasi chakka bo'lagi jarrohligida himoyalanishi shart — yo'qolishi chakka bo'lagi venoz infarktini beradi.

description.en: The veins of the cerebellum and brainstem: superior cerebellar veins drain up to the great vein and straight sinus, inferior ones to the transverse and sigmoid sinuses, and the pontine and medullary veins drain the brainstem surface.
description.uz: Miyacha va miya ustuni venalari: yuqori miyacha venalari katta vena va to'g'ri sinusga, pastkilari ko'ndalang va sigmasimon sinuslarga, ko'prik va uzunchoq miya venalari miya ustuni yuzasini drenajlaydi.

role.en: Venous drainage of the posterior fossa.
role.uz: Orqa chuqurchaning venoz drenaji.

clinical.en: The petrosal vein (Dandy's vein) is often sacrificed in microvascular decompression; venous infarction can follow.
clinical.uz: Toshsimon vena (Dandy venasi) mikrovaskulyar dekompressiyada tez-tez qurbon qilinadi; venoz infarkt kelib chiqishi mumkin.

description.en: The main vein of the orbit, running back through the superior orbital fissure into the cavernous sinus; it communicates in front with the facial (angular) vein and has no valves.
description.uz: Ko'z kosasining asosiy venasi; yuqori ko'z kosasi yorig'i orqali orqaga g'orsimon sinusga boradi; oldida yuz (burchak) venasi bilan bog'langan va klapanlari yo'q.

role.en: Drains the eye and orbit.
role.uz: Ko'z va ko'z kosasini drenajlaydi.

clinical.en: The route by which infection from the 'danger triangle' of the face reaches the cavernous sinus; dilated in carotid-cavernous fistula.
clinical.uz: Yuzning 'xavfli uchburchagi'dan infeksiyaning g'orsimon sinusga yetish yo'li; karotid-kavernoz fistulada kengayadi.

description.en: Begins at the jugular foramen as the continuation of the sigmoid sinus (jugular bulb) and descends the neck in the carotid sheath, lateral to the carotid artery, to join the subclavian vein.
description.uz: Bo'yinturuq teshigida sigmasimon sinus davomi (bo'yinturuq piyozchasi) sifatida boshlanib, uyqu arteriyasi qinida undan lateral holda bo'yin bo'ylab tushib o'mrov osti venasiga qo'shiladi.

role.en: The main venous outflow of the brain, face and neck.
role.uz: Miya, yuz va bo'yinning asosiy venoz chiqish yo'li.

clinical.en: Used for central venous lines (ultrasound-guided); its pulse pressure (JVP) reflects right-heart filling; thrombosis complicates central lines and Lemierre syndrome.
clinical.uz: Markaziy venoz kateterlar uchun ishlatiladi (ultratovush nazoratida); pulsatsiyasi (JVP) o'ng yurak to'lishini aks ettiradi; trombozi markaziy kateterlar va Lemierre sindromida uchraydi.
